adjudication.rationale:
Verified in the diff: in `packages/core/EventManager.ts` `createAllCalendarEvents`, for destinations lacking `credentialId` it does `await Promise.all(destinationCalendarCredentials.map(async (c) => await createEvent(c, event)))` (no `externalId` passed). `packages/core/CalendarManager.ts:createEvent` now echoes that third arg into the returned `EventResult` as `externalId`, and `EventManager` later uses `result.externalId` when persisting references (`externalCalendarId`). Therefore these created references will store `externalCalendarId: undefined`.

This is a behavioral regression vs old code, which stored `evt.destinationCalendar?.externalId` as `externalCalendarId` even when no `credentialId` was present. It also interacts with the new Google calendar selection logic: `GoogleCalendarService.createEvent(calEventRaw, credentialId)` now chooses `calendarId` by `calEventRaw.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.credentialId === credentialId)?.externalId`, so when `credentialId` is absent on destination entries it falls back to `primary`, meaning the event may be created/deleted/updated on the wrong calendar and reschedule/cancel can miss the actual calendar event.
